text:
Proposed 
Interim Policy Statement
on
Replacement Housing
for
Project U 078-1(1)
and
Project I 94-5(49)317
The Wisconsin Division of Highways recognizes that the subject Right of Way projects will require the displacement of eleven families and the demolition of at least four residential units.
Every effort will be made to preserve the existing housing which is decent, safe and sanitary by either encouraging the present owner to move these units to his remainder lands or by making the units available to the public for relocation to another site.
Those displacees who cannot or who do not wish to retain their existing homes will be encouraged to build new replacement homes and will be offered supplemental payments for this purpose in accordance with existing laws.
Upon completion of the projects, a detailed analysis will be made of the net effect these projects had on the housing market. Such analysis will consider units destroyed, units moved and units constructed by displacees.
In the event that the above analysis reveals that these projects have had a negative effect on the existing housing market, the Division of Highways will arrange to replace those units removed from the market. Replacement will be accomplished by the appropriate State agency (not determined as of now).
